Subject: Remittance for Oct invoices + VAT split - Alluvia Technologies

Hi Tessa / Marissa,

Please find attached our remittance file (Alluvia_Remittance_Oct2026.csv) and a PDF statement. We wired two payments to Redwood on 2026-11-18: a USD wire of 145,000.00 (wire REF: AW-118-20261118) and an EUR transfer of 28,456.72 (ACH-equivalent, no detailed invoice refs).

Wire details show the USD was intended to cover INV-1123 in full and the VAT line for INV-1123 (VAT invoice INV-1123-VAT). The EUR transfer is a partial payment against INV-1124 — the remittance line shows only the company name (Alluvia Technologies) and no invoice number. Our bank is attaching an internal clearing reference for the EUR payment; we will follow up with SWIFT details shortly.

Could you confirm:
- How you will allocate the two payments (which invoices get matched).
- Whether the VAT component for INV-1123 was recorded separately in your ledger (we posted VAT as a separate line).
- If anything is unapplied on your side so we can provide missing references.

Attachments: Alluvia_Remittance_Oct2026.csv, Alluvia_Statement_Oct2026.pdf

Thanks,
Tim Hart

- USD 145,000.00 (wire REF AW-118-20261118) has been applied to INV-1123 (133,540.00 USD) and the VAT line INV-1123-VAT (11,464.00 USD). Remaining USD sits as  (we show a small rounding truncation when converting).

Tim — please confirm the VAT registration number you use for EU filings. If the VAT was invoiced as a separate VAT invoice (INV-1123-VAT), we will post it to VAT ledger code 2403; otherwise we need to correct the entry.

Team / Tim,

Thanks for the trace. Finance has applied the USD wire to INV-1123 and INV-1123-VAT in the ledger and posted the EUR CLG-9921 payment to INV-1124 today (posting date 2026-11-22). GL references: 4102-AR-1123 (INV-1123), 2403-VAT-1123 (INV-1123-VAT), 4102-AR-1124 (INV-1124).

We did encounter a tiny currency rounding difference when converting EUR -> GBP in our ledger: a variance of £2.34 remains (system rounding). Rather than leaving an unresolved unapplied balance, Finance proposes issuing a credit memo of £2.34 against INV-1124. I've attached a draft credit memo (credit_memo_draft.pdf) — Marissa, please finalize and post if you agree.

Tim — once you confirm you are okay with a credit memo for the small rounding difference we will close the case on our side. If you'd prefer we can absorb it and issue a one-time adjustment on the next invoice.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Revenue Operations
